title: Vault phone bridge
responsibility: Proxies signed synthetic Vault phone operations for one approved pairing and reads sanitized Vault status for the local Mac.

inputs.name: loadVaultPhone.path
inputs.description: Optional absolute path to the desktop fixture configuration. An omitted, unreadable, or invalid path leaves the inbox disabled.

inputs.name: vaultMacStatus.config
inputs.description: Validated local broker socket and the exact approved Remote device ID and pairing generation designated for Vault.

inputs.name: vaultMacStatus.devices
inputs.description: Current approved Remote devices. The bridge matches both ID and generation before reading the broker.

inputs.name: isVaultPhoneMethod.method
inputs.description: The method of a validated Harness Remote request.

inputs.name: vaultPhone.config
inputs.description: The local synthetic signing origin, Unix broker socket, Vault device ID, and explicitly approved Remote device and generation.

inputs.name: vaultPhone.record
inputs.description: The current authenticated Remote device ID and its pairing generation.

outputs.name: loadVaultPhone
outputs.description: The validated synthetic fixture configuration, or undefined when disabled.

outputs.name: isVaultPhoneMethod
outputs.description: True for Vault identity, challenge, queue, and decision operations.

outputs.name: vaultPhone
outputs.description: A scoped broker caller when the approved device and generation match. Requests with valid proofs produce public identity, a challenge, the synthetic queue, or decision status.

outputs.name: vaultMacStatus
outputs.description: Paired phone name and connection status, with a bounded list of recent synthetic request states. A null request list means the local broker could not provide a valid response. A successful empty reply yields an empty list.

errors.name: RemoteFailure
errors.description: A method-denied rejection if the proof is malformed, names another device, or is refused by the local broker.
